analysis.overall: You had an impressive day with 98% time in range and well-managed meal peaks, though a post-breakfast drop to 62 mg/dL required a quick recovery.

events.title: Smooth lunch coverage
events.description: A 65g carb lunch paired with 4.6u insulin kept your levels very stable, peaking gently at 138 mg/dL before settling back to target.

events.title: Evening drift caught early
events.description: After a minor spike to 156 mg/dL, insulin action pushed your glucose down to 76 mg/dL, but 15g of rescue carbs stabilized you smoothly.

events.title: Dinner peak managed well
events.description: Bolusing 4.1u for 45g of dinner carbs resulted in a brief bump to 150 mg/dL before leveling off cleanly into the evening.

events.title: Bedtime correction
events.description: A late-night rise to 158 mg/dL was addressed with small correction boluses, setting up a flat and predictable overnight period.

events.title: Post-breakfast drop to 62 mg/dL
events.description: The 4.8u dose for 40g of carbs at breakfast hit harder than expected, pulling glucose down to 62 mg/dL before temp targets helped bring it back up.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on breakfast bolus timing or sizing, as the morning dose led to a sharp dip roughly two hours after eating.
